note: Frozen copies used by HVAC Grid. The originals are read only; update a copy here only on purpose and record it (patches: what was changed in the copy, to carry to the original).

patches.what: isRoomNumberText + label numberText: a room number may carry one letter before or after the digits (211T, A12)
openCalEnhance: an open CAL panel loads again when the BOX session or model revision changed (it kept the old drawing)

CAL design conditions: indoor summer default 25 °C / 55 % (ISO 7547:2022 4.2 b; was 27 / 50, the 2002 value under the "4.2" label); BOX's own self test expects 25 / 55 % for rooms without a use (2026-10-21)
CAL AHU heating: supply at most 22 K above the room (ISO 7547:2022 6.3; was 23) and its three labels
CAL solar face mode roof-plus-max-wall (ISO 7547:2022 5.3: the exposed deck and the best wall) - the default of new projects, in the calculation, the room popup and the workbook formulas
patches.test: test/e2e/vendor.e2e.cjs (static checks, BOX host self test 126/126, CAL unit self test 110/110); load workbook formulas checked in Excel

patches.what: CAL room-use temperatures of non-air-conditioned spaces from ISO 7547 Table 1 against the project indoor condition (boiler +28/-17, engine +18/-17, laundry +11/-17, public sanitary +6/0, private +2/0, alleyways / stores / equipment / trunks +2/-5 K)
patches.test: test/e2e/vendor.e2e.cjs (static checks, BOX host self test 126/126, CAL unit self test 110/110); load workbook formulas checked in Excel

patches.what: CAL window conduction on glazing + 200 mm, taken off the wall (ISO 7547 5.2.1, Figures 1-2); solar on the glass - calculation, workbook (column Y, E35, I41) and its layout map; BOX S5 load golden values updated
patches.test: test/e2e/vendor.e2e.cjs (static checks, BOX host self test 126/126, CAL unit self test 110/110); load workbook formulas checked in Excel

patches.what: CAL window solar auto-clear: clear glass without shading Gs 350 W/m2 (ISO 7547 5.3) beside the 240 W/m2 preset
patches.test: test/e2e/vendor.e2e.cjs (static checks, BOX host self test 126/126, CAL unit self test 110/110); load workbook formulas checked in Excel

patches.what: CAL TANK boundary 38 / 5 C and K 0.8 (Table 1 #4, Table 2 #2; was 35 / -20 C on a bare plate K 7.9); NON_AC preset 38 / 5 C
patches.test: test/e2e/vendor.e2e.cjs (static checks, BOX host self test 126/126, CAL unit self test 110/110); load workbook formulas checked in Excel

patches.what: CAL room activity: light work 85 / 150 W a person (ISO 7547 Table 4) beside the project seated values; room popup, calculation, workbook
patches.test: test/e2e/vendor.e2e.cjs (static checks, BOX host self test 126/126, CAL unit self test 110/110); load workbook formulas checked in Excel
